date.as_written: samvat minarituśra /// ekadaśīpradvādasya tithau | jeṣṭapramūlanakṣatre || guruvāsare

notes: The year is given as a word-numeral chronogram, "minarituśra…" (perhaps mīna? + ṛtu = 6 + …), and is cut off, so the year and era cannot be worked out. Era assumed NS but not stated. The king's name is lost except for the ending "…lladeva", so he was a Malla king. "Lalitabrumā" is a corrupt form of Lalitapattana / Lalitapura (Patan). "śrāniglakaḥ" is unclear. "vūvahāra" is probably Bu Bahāḥ in Patan. The owner is a vaidya whose name begins "Jaya…" and breaks off at a lacuna; the colophon presents him as owner of the book (pustako 'yam), not explicitly as scribe. "mayā kaṣṭena likhitaḥ" is a stock verse and names no scribe. The text is called siddhisāra with a nighaṇṭu.
